name: cretan-cat
description: Manousos, a pixel-art Cretan cat above the prompt. Clawd tells him what to do while Claude works, and he answers in mantinades.

language.title: Cretan cat: language
language.description: What Clawd says to Manousos, and Manousos' short replies. The mantinades he sings are always in Greek.

sound.title: Cretan cat: sound
sound.description: A soft meow when the work is done or Claude is waiting for you. Plays on macOS only.
